description: This PHP script is part of the TestLink open source test management tool. It handles copying test plan assignment configurations between builds, managing user rights, initializing page variables, and rendering the user interface components related to build copy actions. The script interacts with several managers and templates to facilitate copying test assignments including validation, data retrieval, and UI setup.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes request parameters, retrieves build and test plan information, and prepares context for further processing.

methods.name: init_gui
methods.description: Prepares GUI components data, including build selection options and messages, for rendering the page.

methods.name: getBuildDomainForGUI
methods.description: Generates HTML options for selecting source builds for copying assignments, including build count info.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Verifies user permissions for accessing test plan planning functionalities.
